acceptanceCriteria.text: Connection-string values never appear in logs, exception messages, or committed files; only variable names, file paths, container names and host:port endpoints are reported.

result.description: On Linux, InstallTestDependencies supplies the PostgreSQL and SQL Server endpoints of the Category=Integration provider tests from the host test-database env file and the dedicated qbrain-test containers (operator decision 2026-10-11, BUG-BASELINE-005), and exports them to the test processes the build starts; Windows provisioning is unchanged.
result.notes: PLAN-C4MODEL-001. Operator answers 2026-10-19: "Fix all 14 in this plan", "Fix 10 here; 4 via PR 82/83", "Trait + Linux provisioning (Recommended)". Operational configuration: the Linux provider lane reads a private test-database env file under the user configuration directory. It supplies MCP_TEST_POSTGRES_CONNECTION and MCP_TEST_SQLSERVER_CONNECTION for the dedicated test containers. Concrete host paths, addresses and container observations belong to execution receipts.
result.title: InstallTestDependencies provisions provider test servers on Linux
